target_customer: Research teams and diagnostic developers needing custom affinity reagents
problem: Producing validated binders such as antibodies for a new target takes months; AI protein design promises weeks.
business_model: Fee for service custom reagent projects

founders.name: Mohamed Hassan Kane
founders.background_notes: YC page: 8 published papers across LLMs, computer vision and protein design.

founders.name: Adil Yusuf
founders.background_notes: Listed on the company site as co-founder; not on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Designing binders with machine learning and validating them in a wet lab is hard for a four to six person team in 2021.

defensibility.rationale: Project data may accumulate, but service customers can buy from others and larger AI protein companies are well funded.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying the service; later AI binder entrants emerged after the batch.

market_need_then: The company reports 25 plus projects and over 10 customers on its site, which are self-reported; demand evidence at founding is not sourced.

branding.domain_note: Uses medium.bio, a .bio domain; the name collides with the blogging site Medium.

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical, fast turnaround in weeks rather than months

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand; the name is shared with a well known publishing platform.

pivots.from: AI-designed protein therapeutics (per an aggregator listing)
pivots.to: Custom affinity reagents for research and diagnostics

outcome_analysis: Medium Biosciences is a very small active company selling AI designed affinity reagents, backed by Y Combinator, AIX Ventures, E14 Fund and Village Global per its own site. No round sizes, exit or shutdown were found, so its outcome is unknown. It serves a niche service market and its funding appears small.
notes: CB Insights lists a seed of about 130K dated Sept 2021 and Dealroom shows 125K, both aggregators; no Form D was found, so no round is recorded as verified. Headquarters conflicts (Austin on YC, Boston or San Francisco elsewhere). The pivot comes from an aggregator and is unverified. The competitor searches found only post-batch entrants and no dated 2021 sources, so the list is empty. Outcome search found no news. Completeness pass: the 130k seed with Y Combinator (CB Insights, Sept 2021) rests on a single database; Bouncewatch dates a round Aug 2021 with unknown amount and Dealroom lists 125k.
